02 · Conversion Mode
Thresholdsoft midtones
Smart Thesisstretched contrast
Pure B&W1-bit · for foiling
Pure B&W (Inv)white bg · black art
Threshold: greyscale invert with smooth midtones — softer, photo-friendly, gradients preserved.

Smart Thesis: pure black bg + pure white text + smooth antialiased edges — best for laser-printing on textured / gold paper.

Pure B&W: 1-bit only — every pixel is either pure black or pure white, no antialiasing. Ideal for hot-foil stamping, screen-print plates, and laser-cut masks.

Pure B&W (Inv): foil-ready — extracts text from PDF and redraws every line at its original position and size as bold black on white. Logos and emblems are kept as greyscale (preserves fine detail and gradients in college crests). No scaling. Ideal for hot-foil thesis covers on gold paper.

Tent Card30×5.5 folded triangle
Name Board30×10.6cm fold-down
Tent Card · 30×5.5cm
Front face printed normally. Back face is auto-flipped 180° so when folded along the spine it stands upright on both sides. Flat sheet = 30×11cm (cut + score down centre).
Exactsingle card
A4210×297 multi
A3297×420 multi
12×18"305×457 multi
13×19"330×483 multi
Custommm
—
Simple Fold2 panels · 30×11
Triangle3 panels + glue · 30×18
Triangle layout (top → bottom): 1.5cm glue tab · 5.5cm back face (flipped) · 5.5cm front face · 5.5cm bottom panel. Total flat sheet 30×18cm. Score on each fold line, fold into triangular tube, glue tab to back of front panel.
Total sheet height = folded face × 2. Visible standing face = half this height.
Common readymade sizes: 30×10.6 · 25×9 · 20×7 · 15×5 (cm).

03 · Continuous Number0001
Quantity means total artwork copies, not sheets. Keep PDF sheets in ascending order, cut the full pile, then combine position stacks left-to-right across each row, top row first. Keep each stack in sheet order. Blank positions are intentional for incomplete jobs. Test a small batch for your printer's face-up/face-down delivery.
Bold
Italic
Click or drag inside any placed artwork to position the selected number. Both positions repeat on every artwork. Numeric edits apply when you leave the field.
04 · 300 DPI PDF Output0 pages
Output is fixed at 300 DPI. Quantity is the total number of printed artwork copies. Copies Per Serial controls when the number advances, including across sheets. An incomplete final repeat group uses only the remaining quantity.

About these settings:
• 90–150 DPI is for fast previews and customer proofs.
• 300 DPI is the print-shop default for finished work.
• 360 DPI is useful for many inkjet workflows.
• 600 DPI is reserved for fine detail and is processed one sheet at a time.
